VI.description: Tells RemoteVI Start.vi whether the server is listening\3A sends listener result (the error cluster of TCP Create Listener) on the notifier named <stop notifier name>\3Astarted and releases it. Start.vi has obtained that notifier before it launched the loop and waits on it\2C so a port in use is reported to the caller.
